title.zh: 纽约之行与巨型美术作品
title.en: A Trip to New York and Some Huge Artwork

subtitle.en: Showing the game to journalists at the PS4 launch, Sony's dinners and parties, and our artwork blown up on the side of a 17-story hotel.
subtitle.zh: 在 PS4 发售活动上向记者展示游戏、Sony 的晚宴与派对，以及我们的美术作品被放到 17 层酒店外墙上。

translator.note: 原文的文末一批插图是 WordPress 的缩略图包（点开是大图），译文按全站口径保留原 markdown 作为占位。作者是美术 Orsi Spanyol。

blocks.en: The PS4 launched last week and, though I still barely believe my luck, I got the chance to accompany Jon to the launch event in New York! As it turned out, I was a bit too shy to help him out too much with the questions, but it was still an invaluable experience for someone who has never before been to anything like this event.
blocks.zh: PS4 上周发售了，而我至今还有点不敢相信自己的运气——我得到了陪 Jon 去纽约参加发售活动的机会！结果呢，我太害羞了，没能帮他应付多少提问，但对一个以前从没参加过这类活动的人来说，这仍然是一次无比宝贵的经历。

blocks.en: The interviews happened somewhat randomly. A whole floor of the Standard Hotel was dedicated to indie games that would appear on the PS4, and the press wandered around, peeking into rooms and sitting down to play the games when they were available. I snapped a picture of the room where The Witness was shown:
blocks.zh: 采访的安排有点随性。Standard Hotel 的一整层楼都留给了即将登陆 PS4 的独立游戏，媒体记者在走廊里晃来晃去，往各个房间里探头，看到有空位就坐下来玩。我随手拍了一张《The Witness》展示房间的照片：

blocks.en: We spent two days showing the game to many journalists. They usually played from the beginning for a while, then Jon took them on a guided tour of an area where the puzzles were starting to get a little crazy, explaining the thought process behind them. It was so great to finally see the game being played! Everyone seemed to love it, too!
blocks.zh: 我们花了两天时间向许多记者展示游戏。他们通常先从头玩一会儿，然后 Jon 带他们游览一片谜题开始有点疯狂的区域，讲解这些谜题背后的思路。终于能看着别人玩这款游戏，感觉太好了！而且大家似乎都很喜欢！

blocks.en: During the nights, we were invited to a few events. Sony took the indie developers out for dinner, where I met Shuhei Yoshida, and chatted with the guys from Secret Ponchos about goldsmithing and tattoos. It was a good opportunity to get to know the other developers, and a nice gesture by Sony. The next night there was also a bigger, louder party in the penthouse of a tall building, to which local developers were invited as well. It was so full we could barely move, so I just stood around trying to piece together conversation through the incessant club music.
blocks.zh: 晚上我们受邀参加了几场活动。Sony 请独立开发者们出去吃饭，我在那儿见到了 Shuhei Yoshida，还和 Secret Ponchos 那帮人聊了打金工和文身。这是个认识其他开发者的好机会，也是 Sony 的一番好意。第二天晚上，一栋高楼的顶层公寓里还有一场更大、更吵的派对，当地的开发者也受邀参加。人多得几乎挪不动步，我就站在那儿，努力从没完没了的夜店音乐里拼凑出别人在说什么。

blocks.en: By Wednesday we were done with the interviews and I had some time to explore New York and feel totally lazy while Jon got some programming and design done in a cafe. I ended up spending most of the day in the MoMA, where there just happened to be a special Magritte exhibition going. Love Magritte! Oh, and I also got to see Sleep No More, which was a really amazing experience!
blocks.zh: 到周三，采访结束了，我有时间在纽约四处逛、彻底懒散一下，而 Jon 则在一家咖啡馆里写了点程序、做了点设计。结果我大半天都泡在 MoMA，那里正好在办一个 Magritte 特展。太爱 Magritte 了！哦对了，我还去看了 Sleep No More，那真是一次了不起的体验！

blocks.en: The most unbelievable part of the trip for me, however, was seeing our artwork displayed on the side of the 17 story hotel. It was difficult to decipher right up close, since it was displayed on huge sheets of LED lights, but it was wonderful to be right there to see it happen! We took a few pictures but they turned out very blurry, so here are some taken by Kevin Geisler:
blocks.zh: 不过，这趟旅程里最让我难以置信的，是看到我们的美术作品被展示在那栋 17 层酒店的外墙上。因为它是用整片巨大的 LED 灯板显示出来的，凑得很近时反而很难看清，但能亲临现场看着它发生，实在太美妙了！我们自己拍了几张，但都很糊，所以下面是 Kevin Geisler 拍的几张：

blocks.en: Only Alex's windmill and my autumn forest and orchard made it onto the building, but I thought I would include all the original images we submitted, since we put some effort into getting them together. These are pretty high res, in case you guys want to print your own posters or crop them down and make some wallpapers:
blocks.zh: 最终只有 Alex 的风车、以及我的秋日森林和果园上了那栋楼，但我想把我们提交的全部原图都放出来，毕竟凑齐这些图也花了些功夫。这些图分辨率挺高的，如果你们想自己印海报，或者裁一裁拿来做壁纸，都可以用：
